sources.title: SDD: A New Canonical Representation of Propositional Knowledge Bases
sources.role: Sentential Decision Diagrams and vtree-structured canonical compilation.

sources.title: On the relation between structured d-DNNFs and SDDs
sources.role: Exact relationship between structured d-DNNF and SDD representations under a shared vtree.

sources.title: A canonical generalization of OBDD
sources.role: Tree Decision Diagrams as a canonical vtree-based generalization of OBDD; bottom-up compilation related to factor width.

sources.title: Compilation and Fast Model Counting beyond CNF
sources.role: FPT d-DNNF compilation under incidence-treewidth and constraint-language assumptions, including parity-like constraints.

sources.title: Non-FPT lower bounds for structural restrictions of decision DNNF
sources.role: Representation-specific lower bounds separating incidence-treewidth from primal-treewidth compilation behavior.

claim_boundary: The sources establish structured compilation models, positive parameterized results, and model-specific lower bounds; none provides a universal polynomial SAT algorithm or resolves P versus NP.
